خِفْقَةٌ , (K,) or, as in the Tekmileh, ↓ خَفْقَةٌ , (TA,) A thing with which one strikes, or beats, such as a thong, or strap, or a دِرَّة [q. v.]. (K, TA.) [See also مِخْفَقَةٌ.] ＝
-A2- And the former, (K,) or ↓ the latter, (JK,) A smooth desert in which is [the kind of mirage termed] آل: (JK, K:) so says Lth. (TA.) [See also مَخْفَقٌ.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
